findings.message: `proj.web.scores` is partitioned by `bucket`, but the query doesn't filter on it, so it reads every partition (14.4 GB in all).
findings.fix: Add a filter on `bucket`, limiting it to a range of values.

findings.message: `LIMIT 10` doesn't reduce the bytes billed: selecting `*` reads every column of `proj.web.scores` in the partitions the query touches, about 14.4 GB.
findings.fix: Select only the columns you need. For column names and types, use `scanisaur_schema_describe`, which reads no data.
